task.summary: Design the gate package required before a later candidate-only SkillSelection repair training/eval slice can be authorized.
minimumContent: Use all 8 P27 rows only as local-private candidate rows, not common training rows.
Split design must separate train/dev/eval by source_family, pair_id, source_hash, targetAdapter, selectedSkills, and prompt summary features.
Explicitly state whether 8 rows are enough for training or only enough for a design gate; do not invent rows.
Define candidate-only training authorization matrix with required parent approval fields.
Define leakage gates for exact prompt, source id, path, filename, pair id, row ordinal, candidate order, selected-skill position, and target adapter shortcut.
Define required future P30 training/eval gates without running them: fresh-load, continue-training, export/import, ablation, dashboard/runtime evidence, no promotion.
